bcc-ed Dave in case he wants to join stan-dev and follow along,
or you can cc him all you want]

Alp (& Dustin):

Just create an issue for the doc in the Stan manual (in stan-dev/stan)
and then create a branch. These are easy to review and merge and
we can do it as soon as it's done.

Please create issues for things you're going to do after it's decided
they should be done. Much easier to track than email to a limited recipient
circle.

Thanks,

- Bob
